{{Quote|When I was first given this assignment, I believed it would be an excellent opportunity to serve the Republic. I underestimated. It has been the greatest honor of my life.|Sergeant Fideltin Rusk, on his time with the Hero of Tython|<ref name="TDI">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|The Drill Instructor}}</ref>}}
'''Fideltin Rusk''' was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Republic soldier|soldier]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] in [[3682 BBY]] and raised by a [[Chagrian colony|colony]] of pacifists on [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]], the Chagrian enlisted in the military as soon as possible and became devoted to defending those who could not defend themselves. He soon gained a reputation as a determined and skilled [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] with [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of experience against the Empire, criminals, and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] across a wide range of battlefields. He was considered a pariah by his fellows because of his belief that [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were meant to be used regardless of the consequences.

During the tense Cold War with the Sith Empire, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Rusk was stationed with the [[301st Infantry]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he battled both the Empire and the [[White Maw]] pirate organization. Around [[3642 BBY]], [[Fideltin Rusk's squad|Rusk's unit]] was assigned to aid the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Leeha Narezz]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] in their [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|mission]] to recover the plans for the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]]. Together with the two Knights, Rusk and his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] fought both pirates and Imperials across the world's icy surface as they searched for the plans, and afterward the sergeant was assigned to the Hero's crew on a permanent assignment. Rusk [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress|accompanied]] the Knight and the other members of the crew to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Space station/Legends|station]], but they were [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] for [[Standard month/Legends|months]] when the Hero and the other members of the [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|Jedi strike team]] were turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and [[Sith training|trained]] as Sith.

After the [[Emperor's Wrath]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], betrayed his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] to free the Hero and crew from the station, the Wrath revealed that the Emperor planned to consume all life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as part of a [[Sith Emperor's ritual|dark ritual]] and joined the Jedi's crew in an effort to stop him. As the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] became consumed in renewed war, Rusk accompanied the Hero and the rest of the crew as they traveled to the planets [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], [[Voss]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in order to stop the Emperor's agents from committing [[Speciecide|genocide]] and rescued the strike team members from their enemy's control. In a final showdown, Rusk and the rest of the crew fought the forces of the Empire on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] while the Hero and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] faced and [[Dromund Kaas operation|defeated]] the Emperor in battle.

Their mission completed, the Hero and their five companions were awarded the prestigious medal known as the [[Cross of Glory]] by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]], and Rusk continued to travel the galaxy with the group and aid those in need during the conflict. Following the Hero of Tython's disappearance during the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|invasion]], the crew went their separate ways. Rusk returned to the Republic Military and was given command of the [[Dead Man's Legion]], a regiment of conscripted convicts, which was dispatched to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by order of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Jebevel Madon]] to deal with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] syndicate.

==Biography==
===Early career===
{{Quote|I came from a pacifist colony, Master Jedi. We were bullied remorselessly: by pirates, corporations, Hutts, even governments. I joined the military as soon as I could. Peace only comes to those willing to fight for it.|Rusk|audio=Rusk1.flac|<ref name="Passive Resistance" />}}
[[File:Rusk_Salute.png|thumb|right|250px|Joining the military allowed Rusk to defend those who could not or would not defend themselves.]]
The [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="StC" /> Fideltin Rusk was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[3682 BBY]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> to a [[Fideltin Rusk's father|pair of]] [[Fideltin Rusk's mother|Chagrians]] who lived in a [[Chagrian colony|colony]] of pacifists<ref name="Passive Resistance">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Passive Resistance}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> but quickly began to rebel against his family's beliefs when he realized that the colony's pacifism allowed [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and other enemies to take advantage of them. Rusk enlisted in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] as soon as he could,<ref name="Passive Resistance" /> and became a skilled [[Republic soldier|soldier]] who quickly rose to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Fideltin Rusk's first squad|first squad]] Rusk was assigned to included the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Callan Grayne]], and during one of their missions together Grayne lost his left leg and subsequently acquired a prosthetic. During the war, Rusk served in the [[Geonosis campaign]] with [[Durant]],<ref name="The Price of Victory" /> a man who would eventually become a [[General/Legends|general]] in [[Republic High Command/Legends|Republic High Command]].<ref name="General Durant">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|General Durant|Taris}}</ref>

Rusk's first assignment as a sergeant with his [[Surgeons|new squad]] was to liberate [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war from a relatively undefended [[Imperial outpost (prison camp)|Imperial outpost]]; intelligence claimed that Imperial reinforcements would not arrive for another twenty-four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. The Intelligence was incorrect&mdash;the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] was heavily guarded, and Rusk's [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was outnumbered ten to one. However, they [[Attack on an Imperial outpost|fought]] against overwhelming odds and escaped successfully with the prisoners, with almost every member of the squad sustaining heavy injuries but with no [[Death/Legends|fatalities]] among the prisoners or Rusk's unit. The Chagrian went on to consider the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in his first squad to be the finest he had ever commanded,<ref name="Bad Intel">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Bad Intel}}</ref> and he continued to serve with other units while his squadmates&mdash;including [[Karsim]], [[Naja]], and [[Eckerd]]&mdash;were recruited by General [[Elin Garza]] into the [[Special Forces black ops program|black ops program]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]].<ref name="The Surgeons" />

===Reckless commander===
{{Quote|I held a single-entrance fortress similar to this on Amador. Enemy bodies were stacked twenty-high around the outside when that battle was over.|Fideltin Rusk|<ref name="Ambient">{{TORcite|Ambient Conversation on Voss}}</ref>}}
[[File:OhNoYouDidnt-SWTOR.png|thumb|left|250px|Rusk was well known for his lack of tolerance for insubordination.]]
At some point during the war, Rusk [[Battle on Amador|defended]] a [[Amador fortress|fortress]] on<ref name="Ambient" /> the planet<ref name="Acts">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 1|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 1]]</ref> [[Amador]], and he single-handedly fought off dozens of [[Imperial soldier]]s while holding the building's single entrance. By the end of the battle, Rusk had killed so many enemies that he was able to build veritable walls from their bodies.<ref name="Ambient" /> While he was initially considered a remarkable [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] and excellent soldier, it was not long before Rusk's commanding [[Republic officer/Legends|officers]] began to receive reports of recklessness from his fellows. He was soon considered a pariah by many of the military's top leaders, as his determination and loyalty to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] were overshadowed by what many considered to be reckless disregard for the lives of his soldiers.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Sergeant Fideltin Rusk (Knight)}}</ref> Republic High Command soon began to keep a tally of the number of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that Rusk's victories cost the government, and,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> by [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|2}}</ref> it was well over 70,000,000. During his career, Rusk faced a total of twelve military tribunals over charges ranging from accusing his superior [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of cowardice to reckless endangerment of an entire [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

While Rusk was acquitted each [[Time/Legends|time]] and given a medal, he was denied a promotion<ref name="Encyclopedia" />&mdash;and while other soldiers gained recognition and commendations, he was passed over and remained a sergeant personally leading squads into battle.<ref name="Codex" /> He soon gained the unofficial call sign "Undertaker" as a result of the number of casualties among both his subordinates and superiors; yet he continued to have an incredible success rate in his missions.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Rusk's behavior worsened around the end of the war when he learned that his [[Parent/Legends|parents']] colony had been [[Attack on Mindor|wiped out]] by the Empire<ref name="Holonet" /> in [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]].<ref name="Mindor-Date">Act III of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' occurs in [[3640 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates/3|here]]. In {{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Passive Resistance}}, which takes place in Act III, Fideltin Rusk states the [[attack on Mindor]] occurred ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior.</ref> Rusk's persistent attitude resulted in a series of assignments throughout the tenuous conflict known as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on remote and combat-heavy environments, often against heavy opposition.<ref name="Holonet" />

===Time on Hoth===
{{Quote|You're looking for a detachment from the 301st Infantry, led by Sergeant Rusk. His squad is being overrun by Imperial probe droids.|Leeha Narezz asks the Hero of Tython to aid Rusk|<ref name="Suicide Squads" />}}
Rusk spent the later part of the next [[Standard year/Legends|decade]] on the remote [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he was stationed as part of a detachment from the [[301st Infantry]]. Still a sergeant, Rusk aided the forces of the Republic Military<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> as they battled pirates from the [[White Maw]] organization.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Sub-Zero Showdown|Hoth}}</ref> The Republic's main goal on the planet was salvage: the planet's icy [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric conditions]] preserved the wrecks of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] remarkably well, and the planet contained numerous wrecks.<ref name="Starship Graveyard">{{TORcite|type=codex|Starship Graveyard}}</ref> In [[3665 BBY]],<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]] had been the site of a massive [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|space battle]] that had sent hundreds of Republic and Imperial starships crashing to the surface.<ref name="Starship Graveyard" /> As tensions rose and the Cold War's peace collapsed, leading to the start of the [[Galactic War]],<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> the Empire returned to Hoth and triggered a desperate scramble by the Republic to recover whatever remained of the technology and [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] that had been lost during the battle.<ref name="Starship Graveyard" /> The Empire's true goal was actually to tie down Republic resources in an unwinnable battle and thereby draw them out into open war, and the Republic obliged by continuing to funnel [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and supplies to the salvage effort.<ref name="Imperial War Strategy: Quagmires">{{TORcite|type=codex|Imperial War Strategy: Quagmires}}</ref>

{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
[[File:Rusk_and_Murtag.png|thumb|right|250px|Murtag and Rusk were the only survivors of their six-man squad.]]
Not long after the Empire's arrival, Sergeant Rusk and the 301st Infantry received a special assignment from General Grayne<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> around 3642 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> The unit would have been working with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leeha Narezz]] and another Knight<ref name="Suicide Squads" />&mdash;the one known as the [[Hero of Tython]] for actions during the [[Desolator crisis|recent conflict]] with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] a [[3643 BBY|year prior]]<ref name="Fate of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Fate of the Jedi|Tython}}</ref>&mdash;in a classified [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|mission]] about which the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were not willing to share information.<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> What Rusk was allowed to know was that they were searching for the ''[[Deference]]'', a [[Pythar-class Imperial shuttlecraft|''Pythar''-class Imperial shuttlecraft]] that had belonged to an [[Unidentified Imperial scientist|Imperial scientist]] before the man had been shot down during the battle over two decades prior. The two Knights were searching for the plans for the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]], a set of which had been aboard the ''Deference'' at the time of the crash.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

However, by the time the Hero and crew arrived on the planet at [[Aurek Base]], the Republic's main command center, Rusk's unit had been sent on a mission to retrieve Imperial survey maps of the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]], and they had been pursued by the Imperials after securing the files. He and the other five members of his unit had been pinned down in an [[Crescent Canyon Ortolan outpost|outpost]] belonging to [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] colonists in [[Crescent Canyon]], with the Imperials using [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] as weapons against the soldiers. The probe [[Droid/Legends|droids]] rapidly approached the Republic infantry and then [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|detonated]] when they were close enough, making suicide runs in attempts to kill the entrenched soldiers.<ref name="Suicide Squads" />

===Working with the Jedi===
{{Quote|Saving the galaxy requires sacrifice. We're all expendable to the mission, soldier.|Rusk, to his subordinate|<ref name="Position of Power" />}}
Rusk's unit managed to send a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] to Narezz before their communications were [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]], and the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] Jedi sent the recently arrived Hero to their rescue. The Knight and a companion stormed the outpost, quickly cutting through the attacking Imperials and removing the immediate threat to the 301st. The Hero then spoke briefly with Rusk and the only other survivor of his unit, [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Murtag]], before the Jedi was forced to fight off a second wave of probe droids while the Chagrian defended his wounded subordinate. After the battle ended, Rusk escorted the injured Murtag to the nearest [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] and informed the Knight that he would meet back up with the Jedi at Narezz's location with a new squad.<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> Returning to Aurek Base after entrusting Murtag to [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], Rusk selected a new five-man squad consisting of Privates [[Edder]], [[Reico]], [[Vanth]], [[Voshpar]], and [[Dromol]]. However, on the way to [[Outpost Cresh]] to meet with the two Jedi, Rusk was contacted by Narezz with a new assignment. She revealed that an Imperial by the name of [[Imperial Guard|Guardsman]] [[Lassicar]] was [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] the two Jedi, planning to capture them, and she wanted to set a trap for him at the site of the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Narezz ordered Rusk and his men to wait for her signal to enter the [[Cave/Legends|caves]] where the shuttle had crashed.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

[[File:Hoth_Rusk_Fight.png|thumb|left|280px|Sergeant Rusk's squad in battle]]
Narezz's plan worked perfectly&mdash;within moments of Lassicar's men arriving in the caves, Rusk and his men rappelled down through the cavern's ceiling and turned the odds in the two Jedi's favor. Together with the Hero's help, the squad won the fight and left none of Lassicar's [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] standing. However, Rusk's inexperienced squadmates quickly turned to bickering among themselves, causing the Chagrian to order his subordinates to stand down and cease their insubordination. The Hero came to Rusk's aid, reminding the squad how it was their duty to put aside emotion in battle and do their duty to the Republic&mdash;a speech with which the sergeant agreed wholeheartedly. Meanwhile, Narezz had discovered an Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] by the name of [[Urrisov]] hiding in the remains of the ''Deference'', and Rusk immediately began to aggressively interrogate the scared, young Human.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

The Hero intervened and calmly convinced Urrisov to tell the group what they needed to know. The Jedi and the soldiers were dismayed to learn that the White Maw pirates had reached the ''Deference'' first and stolen the shuttle's databank&mdash;which had contained the fortress plans sought by the Jedi. From his encounters with the pirates during his service on Hoth, Rusk knew that the pirates moved all of their scavenged material through the wrecked dreadnaught ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' deep in the Starship Graveyard, a region where many of the ships had crashed.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

===Confronting the Maw===
{{Quote|My men are up to the task, Master Jedi. We won't let you down.|Rusk, to the Hero of Tython|<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />}}
[[File:Narezz_and_Rusk_plan.png|thumb|right|250px|Sergeant Rusk, Leeha Narezz, and the Hero plan their attack.]]
The pirate depot in the wreck was protected by a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] that was powered by two [[Power generator/Legends|generators]], and the Hero departed to take out one of the reactors while Rusk's squad traveled to the other facility. Before their attack, Rusk and his men were ordered by General Grayne to eliminate the White Maw's munitions stockpiles nearby, and Rusk contacted the Knight to inform the Jedi of the additional mission. The 301st were successful in completing their assignment, although Vanth and Voshpar sustained minor injuries. They then rendezvoused with Narezz and the Hero at [[Outpost Zerek]] near the Graveyard.<ref name="Position of Power">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Position of Power|Hoth}}</ref>

There, Rusk began to plan the attack with Narezz and the other Knight. The databank for which they were searching was located near the center of the dreadnaught, but there was a problem&mdash;Imperial and White Maw forces were battling for control of the ship, so both groups had strike teams at either end of the vessel.<ref name="Position of Power" /> Thinking it over, Rusk believed that his men would have a better chance against the pirates&mdash;the undisciplined criminals were more likely to panic when under attack than the Imperials. While the two groups engaged their enemies, Narezz and an [[ME-D1|ME-D]] droid would retrieve the databank, so the three teams set off through the Graveyard. Fighting through the White Maw forces that controlled the region, Rusk's unit headed to the fore section of the ''Star'' and cleared a path through the wrecked dreadnaught to the fore [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay. Within the hangar, Rusk and his men fought the White Maw strike force and killed their [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] leader, [[Zeshatt]], escaping with no casualties.<ref name="The Imperial Guard">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Imperial Guard|Hoth}}</ref>

===A new assignment===
{{Quote|I can't waste a soldier like Rusk on shore leave, so I'm assigning him to you.|General Callan Grayne, to the Hero of Tython|<ref name="The Price of Victory" />}}
[[File:Rusk_on_ship.png|thumb|left|250px|Sergeant Rusk became the fourth member of the Hero's crew.]]
Rusk and his victorious unit returned to Outpost Zerek, where they took [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] back to Aurek Base to meet with a successful Narezz and the Hero. There, the Chagrian was also surprised to learn from Grayne that he was permanently being assigned to the Jedi Knight's squad, as the 301st was being rotated back to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Rusk took his place among the Hero's crew, meeting the other members of the team: the wise-cracking [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]], the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], and [[Kira Carsen]], the former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the Hero.<ref name="The Price of Victory" />

Having completed their assignment on Hoth, the group departed aboard their [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]] to return to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], where the Hero met with the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="Descent">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Descent|the Emperor's Fortress}}</ref> Rusk and the others joined the Hero's [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress|mission]] to infiltrate the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], but remained on the ship as the Hero and Carsen disembarked to meet the other members of their [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|strike team]]&mdash;Narezz and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Tol Braga]] and [[Warren Sedoru]]. However, events took a turn when the Emperor [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|dominated the minds]] of the Jedi, turning them to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and making them his servants.<ref name="Descent" />

Captured by the Emperor's guards, Rusk spent several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] imprisoned with Doc, T7-O1, and Carsen while the Hero underwent [[Sith training|training]] as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. However, when the Knight was freed from the Emperor's control by the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of the Jedi's former Master, [[Orgus Din]], Rusk was rescued from his cell by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], the [[Emperor's Wrath]]. Despite being a Sith, the Wrath pledged his loyalty to the Hero, and accompanied the crew back to Tython, where he explained that the Emperor was planning to consume all life in the galaxy through a [[Sith Emperor's ritual|dark ritual]]. He had [[Force vision/Legends|foreseen]] that only the Hero of Tython would be able to defeat his former Master, for which reason he allied himself with the Knight.<ref name="An Unthinkable Alliance">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|An Unthinkable Alliance|the Emperor's Fortress}}</ref>

===Race against doomsday===
{{Quote|An assault on Dromund Kaas. This is the mission I've always wanted.|Rusk|<ref name="Doomsday">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Doomsday|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>}}
With Scourge as an uneasy ally, the Hero and crew traveled to the prison planet of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where they worked to stop a fanatical Imperial officer by the name of [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]]<ref name="Anarchy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Anarchy|Belsavis}}</ref> from detonating the [[Central power core|planet's core]] and killing everyone on-world.<ref name="Holocaust">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Holocaust|Belsavis}}</ref> Rusk and the others then accompanied the Knight to the [[Korriban's Flame]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] station, where the Jedi fought and redeemed a corrupted Narezz.<ref name="Fallen">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Fallen|the Korriban's Flame}}</ref> The group's next [[Mission to Voss (Emperor's ritual crisis)|mission]] was to the planet [[Voss]], where the group battled the [[Sith sorcerer]] Lord [[Fulminiss]] and prevented him from releasing the malevolent entity known as [[Sel-Makor]].<ref name="Mysterious World">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Mysterious World|Voss}}</ref> After successfully stopping Sel-Makor from unleashing a plague of homicidal madness upon the world,<ref name="Visions of Light and Darkness">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Visions of Light and Darkness|Voss}}</ref> Rusk and the Hero's allies fought the fallen Master Sedoru when he [[Battle of the Valiant|captured]] the Republic [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Valiant (Valor-class)|''Valiant'']].<ref name="Irredeemable">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Irredeemable|the ''Valiant''}}</ref>

[[File:Fideltin_Rusk_on_Dromund_Kaas.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rusk on Dromund Kaas, traveling with the crew to the Dark Temple.]]
When the Hero was appointed [[Supreme Commander (Jedi)|Supreme Commander]] of all Jedi forces in the [[Battle of Corellia]], Rusk and the crew accompanied the Knight to the contested [[Corellia/Legends|world]]. Joining forces with the Republic Military under General [[Var Suthra]], the Knight led Jedi in battles across the capital of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] as the fallen Master Braga attempted to massacre hundreds of innocents in an attempt to start the Emperor's ritual.<ref name="Jedi Commander">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Jedi Commander|Corellia}}</ref> Finally defeating and redeeming the Jedi Master in a battle above the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Governmental Sector|government district]],<ref name="Mutual Assured Destruction">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Mutual Assured Destruction|Corellia}}</ref> the group prepared to stage a final assault upon the Emperor while [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] and several of the Hero's companions launched an attack on the Imperial capital of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Doomsday" />

Together with T7-O1, the Hero managed to strike down the Emperor in a [[Dromund Kaas operation|final duel]]. Rusk was awarded the [[Cross of Glory]], the Republic's highest honor, along with the rest of the Hero's crew by Grand Master Shan on the ''Valiant''.<ref name="Doomsday" /> Although the threat of the Emperor was ended, the galaxy was still consumed in war, so the Hero and crew continued to travel from planet to planet aboard their ship, aiding those in need.<ref name="Crystal Ball">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Crystal Ball|Ilum}}</ref> During his tenure with the Hero, Rusk investigated the fates of his original squad members, and was dismayed to learn that the Surgeons, as they had renamed themselves, had been arrested for war crimes&mdash;instead of simply targeting top Imperial leaders as they had been ordered, the group had begun targeting the Imperials' families as well. As a result, General Garza was forced to imprison them on [[Berrun]], where each member served life sentences.<ref name="The Surgeons" />

===Without the Jedi===
{{Quote|I have an outfit of hardened criminals that would like nothing more than to shoot me in the back. Zero tolerance means execution. For them, at least.|Rusk, on the Dead Man's Legion|<ref name="Alliance" />}}
[[File:Dead_Mans_Legion.png|thumb|left|300px|Rusk commanding the Dead Man's Legion.]]
Rusk continued to serve under the Hero of Tython's command for several years until the Jedi Master disappeared<ref name="KOTFE">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=1}}</ref> around the year [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="KOTFE date">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> the same time that the [[Eternal Empire]] of the planet [[Zakuul]] invaded both the Empire and the Republic.<ref name="KOTFE" /> Like the rest of the Hero's crew, Rusk spent time searching for the missing Jedi, but eventually returned to military service amidst the Sith Empire and Republic's battle with and eventual capitulation to the Eternal Empire.<ref name="Alliance" />

By [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Alert Date">{{TOR_updates|4.7}}</ref> Rusk had been promoted to the rank of [[Provost Marshal]] and given command of the [[Dead Man's Legion]], a military police unit that consisted of criminals forcibly conscripted into service. Under the orders of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Jebevel Madon]], the Dead Man's Legion was deployed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where they claimed part of the [[Ternion Building]] as Republic territory under the [[Makeb treaty]] with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. Using that area as a base, Rusk's men pursued members of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate that had fled the Legion's campaign against them on Coruscant, and he was engaged in that [[Operation Sunset|conflict]] when he was approached by the [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]], the leader of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against Zakuul, with the offer of joining the Alliance. The Commander had been informed of Rusk's location by the former Republic [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo]], and arrived just as Rusk was reprimanding his subordinate [[Merghal]].<ref name="Alliance" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I've been waiting my whole life for a chance to deliver a decisive victory to the Republic. If I may say so, the Jedi Order's discipline, self-sacrifice and devotion to duty are a model for all citizens.|Rusk, to the Hero of Tython|<ref name="Welcome Rusk">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Welcome Rusk}}</ref>}}
A [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned Chagrian male with blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and dark grey [[Lethorn/Legends|lethorns]],<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> Fideltin Rusk began to chafe under his family's pacifist ideals when he realized that they allowed others to take advantage of them. At the first chance, he enlisted in the Republic Military and quickly found his calling as a soldier on the front line.<ref name="Codex" /> Rusk believed that peace was only worth having if it was fought for, and despised the Sith Empire for crushing the liberties of innocent civilians.<ref name="Passive Resistance" /> He viewed that soldiers were meant to be used, and that while their loss did hurt the Republic, not using soldiers to their full potential was a waste of resources.<ref name="Welcome Rusk" /> Rusk's view led him to despise insubordination, making him become furious whenever any of his subordinates questioned his orders.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

[[File:Rusk_and_his_numbers.png|thumb|right|250px|Rusk often applied percentages and statistics to combat readiness and casualty rates.]]
While his determination and drive to defend the Republic was praised by many, Rusk's consistently high casualty rates gave him a bad reputation among the military's leaders.<ref name="Codex" /> His apparent disregard for the safety of his men was misunderstood by those who did not know him,<ref name="Bad Intel" /> so he seemed to take reckless and unnecessary risks in his assignments&mdash;a trait that only increased after the death of his parents.<ref name="Codex" /> However, while Rusk was viewed by many as a loose cannon in the field, not even his fellow soldiers could deny that the sergeant's presence on any mission almost certainly guaranteed success.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The Chagrian greatly respected his original squad and was dismayed to learn that they had overstepped boundaries during their time in the Republic Special Forces.<ref name="The Path Not Taken">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|The Path Not Taken}}</ref>

While Rusk opposed the Empire with all his might, both him and the Hero agreed that women and [[Youngling/Legends|children]]&mdash;innocents&mdash;should never be targeted. Unlike his former squadmates, he knew where the line was and when to stop.<ref name="The Path Not Taken" /> However, in the absence of the Hero of Tython's influence after the Jedi disappeared, Rusk willingly embraced the martial leadership of Chancellor [[Leontyne Saresh]] and her successor Madon, and was more than willing to lead a unit of criminals who he forcibly conscripted into service.<ref name="Alliance" />

A military man, Rusk applied a mindset of statistical efficiency to much of his life, and frequently referred to things such as combat readiness, casualty rates, and tactical advantages in the form of percentages.<ref name="Bad Intel" /> He greatly respected the Jedi Order for their devotion to the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]], and believed that the Republic Military would be far better off if they adopted the Order's teachings on internal peace and setting aside emotions during battle. He also greatly appreciated being given a challenge with seemingly impossible odds, such as the defeat of the Sith Emperor, as he believed that wars were won by meaningful sacrifices on behalf of those fighting for the right causes.<ref name="Welcome Rusk" /> Rusk's military mindset often crossed over into his [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] hours, and Doc occasionally found the sergeant cleaning his weapons while sleepwalking.<ref name="Extra crew quarters">{{TORcite|type=message|Extra crew quarters|Doc}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|He can hold a rifle. That's all the mission requires.|Rusk, on one of his subordinates|<ref name="Suicide Squads" />}}
A trained member of the Republic Military, Rusk was officially classified as a heavy-[[Armor/Legends|armored]] ranged [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] specialist, proficient with both standard [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and many types of heavy weaponry.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> He was an experienced commander, having spent decades of his career leading squads into battle, although Rusk's superiors had a low opinion of the high casualty rates that his units suffered.<ref name="Codex" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|I've been analyzing your battle tactics, Master Jedi. I hope you don't mind. I believe I've found a way to increase my own combat efficiency by another twenty-five point four percent.|Rusk, to the Hero of Tython|<ref name="Tactics">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Tactics}}</ref>}}
[[File:RuskGun-TOR.png|thumb|left|250px|Rusk utilized blaster rifles and repeating blaster cannons in combat.]]
As a member of the 301st Infantry on Hoth, Sergeant Rusk wore a standard set of solid white [[Republic trooper]] armor with light blue markings over a black [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]], although he would utilize various armor sets in different environments while accompanying the Hero of Tython. His Chagrian physiology prevented him from wearing a standard [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]], so he chose to forgo it and allowed his lethorns to hang freely.<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> Although he was trained to use many types of heavy weaponry,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Rusk wielded a standard-issue [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] while assigned to the 301st Infantry. When he was transferred to the Hero of Tython's crew, the sergeant chose to requisition a heavy [[Repeating blaster cannon/Legends|repeating blaster cannon]], which he carried strapped to his back when it was not in use.<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> He also utilized [[thermal grenade]]s and weapon attachments that allowed him to fire charged beams of energy at opponents.<ref name="Ability">{{TORcite|Sergeant Rusk's Abilities}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
===Companion to the Jedi Knight===
{{Quote|If Sergeant Rusk ate all the energy pudding again, I'm gonna be upset. That man has no respect for other people's food.|Doc, during one of his optional companion conversations|<ref name="StC" />}}
Fideltin Rusk first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Suicide Squads" /> First mentioned in an entry on [[the Holonet]] portion of the game's website, Rusk is a companion character for the Jedi Knight class;<ref name="Holonet" /> he appears in-game as "Sergeant Rusk" and is acquired after completion of the class storyline on Hoth during Act II.<ref name="The Price of Victory" /> Rusk is voiced by [[Ron Yuan]].<ref name="Manual">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> In ''The Old Republic'', players can gain or lose affection with companion characters depending on their actions and decisions. Rusk gains affection when the player kills Imperials, protects the Republic, and motivates others to fight. However, he loses affection when the player avoids fights, shows weakness, or disrespects authority.<ref name="Holonet" /> Rusk was created and written into the Knight storyline by BioWare writer [[Hall Hood]], and [[Mary Kirby]] wrote Rusk's companion conversations.<ref name="Twitter plot">{{Twitter|hallhood|status/200815190726545409|[[Hall Hood]]|archivedate=20160128101415}}</ref> Hood was inspired by [[Wikipedia:Michael Ironside|Michael Ironside's]] [[W:c:starshiptroopers:Jean Rasczak|character]] in the movie [[Wikipedia:Starship Troopers (film)|''Starship Troopers'']] while creating Rusk,<ref name="Inspiration">{{Twitter|hallhood|status/259050282930012161|[[Hall Hood]]|archivedate=20160128101437}}</ref> and his original idea for the character included Rusk as a Chagrian.<ref name="Chagr">{{Twitter|hallhood|status/259051116107550721|[[Hall Hood]]|archivedate=20160128101525}}</ref>

[[File:Fideltin_Rusk.png|thumb|right|250px|Sergeant Rusk is one of the last companions acquired by the Jedi Knight class.]]
As a companion character, Sergeant Rusk is one of six characters that can be utilized by player characters.<ref name="Holonet" /> Unlike companions such as T7-O1 and Kira Carsen, he is not required to accompany the player character on any class missions. Therefore, this article assumes that only one of the companions accompanies the Knight on the class missions but does not specify which one. Also, as a Republic character, the Jedi Knight is assumed to be a [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] character, and therefore the Hero of Tython, the in-game title for the character, is assumed to choose only options that result in the maximum light side points.

The final mission on Hoth has two possible paths: the first, "The Imperial Guard," has the player fight Lassicar and his men in the aft section of the ''Star of Coruscant'',<ref name="The Imperial Guard" /> while the second, "The White Maw," has the Jedi fight Zeshatt and the pirates in the fore section. Whichever mission the player chooses, Rusk will complete the other, but his squadmates will be killed against the highly-trained Imperials, and the Knight will only go after the White Maw out of vengeance.<ref name="The White Maw">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The White Maw|Hoth}}</ref> Therefore, this article assumes that the Knight allowed Sergeant Rusk to choose, and that his squad survived.

Another game mechanics event occurs in the final mission, "Doomsday." One of the player's companions&mdash;Kira Carsen, Doc, or Rusk&mdash;will come to the Jedi's aid during the attack on the Dark Temple, and the player can choose to save them for light side points and allow the Emperor to gain strength or ignore the distress call for dark side points to continue onward. If the player chooses to leave the companion to their death, they will later learn that one of the other companions saved them. If Sergeant Rusk is the companion in danger, he will be saved by Carsen, while Rusk will save Doc and Doc will save Kira. Regardless, all companions are present on the ''Valiant'' for the end of the class Act.<ref name="Doomsday" />

===Later expansions===
{{Quote|I'll be in touch after things are shored up here. The legion will need a new objective and I'm willing to hear what you're after.|Rusk, if recruited by the player in the Alliance mission|<ref name="Alliance" />}}
[[File:Bg_rusk.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Sergeant Rusk's starting outfit while on Hoth]]
Rusk later appears in the game's Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], which is set several years after the main game and sees him leading a unit of forcibly-enlisted criminals on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="Alliance" /> The Alliance alert "Bonds of Duty," added in Game Update 4.7.1 in [[2016]],<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/972016/game-update-4.7.1-shroud-memory|text=Game Update 4.7.1: Shroud of Memory Patch Notes}}</ref> sees the player character sent to recruit Rusk on Nar Shaddaa, and must reach Rank 10 Influence with him by defeating Black Sun members in the area and retrieving smuggled contraband. Once Rank 10 is reached, Rusk and the player confront the Black Sun leader [[Skadge]]&mdash;a companion character for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] class&mdash;and players can choose to make a deal between them to recruit them both, or pick one to kill for dark side points and then recruit the other.<ref name="Alliance" />

As the player character in the expansion can be any of the eight classes, the alignment choices cannot be assumed, so this article does not assume any outcome of the mission. Rusk has additional dialogue if the player character is a Jedi Knight, but otherwise the mission proceeds as normal.<ref name="Alliance" /> The storyline of Game Update 5.10: Jedi Under Siege presents Imperial players with a choice to join the Sith Empire as an ally or a spy, and if Rusk has been recruited by the player at this point, this will trigger a mail from Rusk informing the Commander that he cannot betray the Republic and will depart from the Alliance, but also stating that he can be contacted if any other threat arises.<ref name="Mail">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=message|The Only Imp I Trust|Provost Marshal Rusk}}</ref>
